seo.title: Nungwi Beach Resort | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: All-inclusive beach resort on Zanzibar’s famous Nungwi beach. Two pools, spa, water sports, and stunning sunset views. From $250/night with half-board.

content:
Set on the powdery white sand of Nungwi—widely considered Zanzibar’s finest beach—this resort delivers the complete tropical escape. The tide barely shifts here, which means you can swim in bathwater-warm turquoise water from dawn to dusk without waiting for tidal changes that affect other parts of the island.

Rooms and suites are arranged in low-rise coral-stone buildings draped in tropical gardens, each with a private balcony or terrace facing either the ocean or the lush grounds. Two swimming pools, including a serene adults-only infinity pool, provide alternatives to the sea, while the spa offers massages and treatments using local coconut and spice oils. Dining is a highlight: the oceanfront restaurant specialises in fresh-caught seafood and Swahili fusion cuisine, and the beach bar is the place to be when the Nungwi sunset paints the sky in every shade of fire. A full water sports centre makes it easy to try kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, or snorkelling right from the beach.
